title: Inspect claim-v2 optional-field serialization
limitations: Read-only git archive; no Git metadata, no remote refresh, no vps-nav.
RFC 0003 is Proposed. Parsers on this base are B1a pure validation, not a public v2 writer or stored ClaimV2 row.
Full repository gate, typecheck, and core package suite were NOT_RUN.
No native/account/model/human qualification or release-acceptance claim.
Artifacts feed P031/P032 and must be reviewed/rebased before production use.
No subject taxonomy, schema migration, or P034 semantic goldens were invented.

findings.summary: Rich v2 claim and producer-response DTOs have no omittable keys. Nullable fields must be present as JSON null. Absence, null, empty string, empty array, extra keys, and JS undefined are distinct.

parseExtractResponseV2 accepts temporal_basis=observed with valid_from=null. validateClaimV2Semantic rejects that combination. Naive JSON copy of a producer draft is not a claim/v2 semantic. RFC 0003 says Core fills observed time at admission.
findings.evidence: producer-v2.ts:444-452; claim-v2.ts:188-190; claim-v2.test.ts:101; rfcs/0003-rich-subject-foundation.md:227-229; roundtrip cases producer-v2/observed-null-valid_from (accept) and boundary/producer-observed-null-as-claim-v2 (reject)

findings.summary: There is no shared ClaimRecord dispatcher. Cross-schema payloads reject. Durable v1 validateClaim ignores extra keys and requires RFC3339 valid_from; producer v1 rejects extra keys and allows null valid_from which admission later fills.
findings.evidence: proposal.ts:149-344,258-260; producer/schema.ts:34-48,78-79; serve/extract.ts:186; claims/store.ts:1088; result.test.ts:77-81; RFC 0003:223-225

findings.summary: JSON.stringify omits undefined object keys. cloneExactJson rejects a present undefined. Serializers must emit explicit null for nullable v2 fields.
claims.valid_from TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' and nullable SQL columns describe v1 storage plus backfillTemporal. They are not a v2 JSON optional-field rule. No v2 semantic table is installed.

next_step: P031/P032 should consume the matrix and fixtures: emit explicit nulls, reject absent/empty aliases, keep producer observed+null off the durable v2 seam until admission fills time, and not treat validateClaim extra-key ignoring as a v2 rule.

must: Treat absent, null, empty string, empty array, extra keys, and undefined as distinct.
Serialize nullable v2 fields as explicit JSON null; never omit them.
Do not JSON-identity round-trip producer-response/v2 drafts through validateClaimV2Semantic.
Keep v1 and v2 schemas on separate parsers; no silent upgrade.
Reuse existing bun tests listed in existing-coverage.json; the /work/out script covers the gap only as a preparation draft.
must_not: Invent subject taxonomy, schema migration, or P034 semantic goldens.
Install RFC 0003 B1b claim_v2_semantics tables from this packet.
Claim native/account/model/human qualification from these artifacts.
